meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Linear 工单评论转为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队用 Linear 管理任务并希望直接在聊天中跟进评论。
copy.tagline_en: Turn Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Linear for task management and wants to follow up comments in chat.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会接入 Linear 频道,自动参与 issue 评论:指定团队的 issue 下有人评论时,Claude 会自动回复,无需 @ 提及。每个 issue 评论串会作为独立对话处理。
howto.when: 当指定 Linear 团队的 issue 下出现新评论时触发,无需 @ 提及,Claude 会自动回应每个评论。

say.text: 请回复 Linear 上 ENG 团队 issue 的最新评论
say.note: Claude 会在对应评论线程中自动回复。

say.text: 在 Linear 的 issue 评论线程里打个招呼
say.note: Claude 第一次回复时会问候对方。

say.text: 帮我把这条 Linear 评论用应用身份回复一下
say.note: 以 OAuth 应用身份发帖,不会过滤你的评论。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude connects to Linear and automatically joins issue comment threads: any new comment on an issue in the configured team triggers a reply, with no @-mention needed. Each issue's comment thread becomes its own conversation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a new comment appears on an issue in the specified Linear team; no @-mention required. Claude automatically responds to each comment.

say_en.text: Please reply to the latest comment on an ENG team issue in Linear.
say_en.note: Claude will reply automatically in that comment thread.

say_en.text: Say hello in the Linear issue comment thread.
say_en.note: Claude greets people when first answering a comment.

say_en.text: Please reply to this Linear comment using the app identity.
say_en.note: Posts as the OAuth app, so your own comments aren't filtered.
